verdict.rationale: The Comptroller documents its own bulk channel: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) for businesses with many outlets, leases, schedules or authorities. It also offers a 'Close One or More Locations' action, and the open-data Socrata endpoint returns multi-row JSON without a key. Beyond those single-line mentions, nothing shows how bulk work is actually done. Missing for 10: documented bulk filing or payment mechanics, an API or agent-usable bulk write surface (OpenAPI probes return 404 and Webfile requires an authenticated session), and hands-on evidence of multi-item operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) is for businesses with a large number of outlets, leases, schedules or authorities.
